subject: english
question:
**Select the word segment that substitutes (replaces) the bracketed word segment correctly and completes the sentence meaningfully. Select the option 'no correction required' if the sentence is correct as given.**

They said that they (were understandings) his theory very well.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Understood**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The sentence is in the past tense, so the correct word should also be in the past tense.
 
• In English, verb tenses indicate when an action occurred.
 
• In this case, "**understood**" is in the past tense, which is suitable for describing an action that happened in the past (i.e., the understanding of the theory).
 
• The verb "understood" agrees with the subject "they" in both number and tense. This ensures that the verb matches the subject correctly.
 
• So, "**understood**" is the correct past tense form of the verb "understand" and fits the sentence meaningfully.

Therefore, the correct answer is **option 4**.

**Corrected sentence**: *They said that they understood his theory very well.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• "**Were understandings**" is grammatically incorrect because "understandings" is a noun and not a verb.
 
• "**Have understand**" is also incorrect because it is in present perfect tense and not past tense.
 
• "**Understanding**" is incorrect because it is in present tense and not past tense.
